## Purpose

Describe the user-visible or security outcome of this change.

## Security impact

- [ ] No trust boundary or security-sensitive behavior changes.
- [ ] Authentication or identity changes.
- [ ] Authorization, tenant scope, or role changes.
- [ ] Storage, retrieval, retention, or deletion changes.
- [ ] Gemini, prompt, tool, upload, or external integration changes.
- [ ] Deployment, IAM, secret, dependency, or logging changes.

For every selected impact, summarize the enforceable control and verification performed.

## Verification

- [ ] Repository policy check passes.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Negative authorization tests were added or updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secret, token, private key, raw private content, or sensitive identifier was added.
- [ ] Public documentation was updated for changed behavior and contains no local-only artifacts.
- [ ] No security claim exceeds the available implementation and test evidence.
